name: Центр (2)
description: The center of the board remains the core of every chess game. Whoever controls the center often has a better position and can attack more easily. By bringing your pieces and pawns to the center, you build a flexible and strong position to pressure your opponent.

examples.text: By advancing the e-pawn, White strengthens the center and opens a diagonal for the bishop.
By placing a pawn in the center, Black strengthens control over the critical square on d4. Additionally, Black prepares the development of the bishop.
